graph_selection: Selected after GPT-5.6 Sol for high strict correctness, certified support, and no normalization effect; selected before benchmark responses from the prospective comparison models.
comparison_limits: Provider medium labels do not equate compute.
No causal training, model-size, or difficulty contrast.
Pointwise cell intervals are not paired model-difference intervals.
Uniform references condition on each model's correct draws.

bootstrap.interval: Pointwise percentile; no multiplicity adjustment; API draws are not separately resampled.
bootstrap.unit: Whole eight-draw prompt groups, paired across conditions by exact original task row.

limitations: This is a separately collected prompt condition, not a replacement for the original cohort or its refusals.
The plain condition was selected after observing original refusals and synthetic development probes; this is an exploratory follow-up.
The shared task prompts justify paired prompt resampling. Sample indices do not pair independent model outputs.
Provider state and collection time can differ. This comparison does not identify a classifier mechanism or a general causal prompting effect.
Collision describes correct answers only, weights prompts by their numbers of correct pairs, and can compare different eligible prompt populations.
Level populations differ; higher benchmark level does not itself establish greater model difficulty.
Static concentration is not evidence of training-induced collapse or zero probability of unobserved modes.

main_display.python_condition: Complete revised Opus 5 Python cohort; original cohorts elsewhere
main_display.population: All eight responses for every held-out prompt
